name: cork_mini
theme: core and envelope told down a cork oak: a dusk dehesa of scattered crowns over umber pasture, the commons beneath them where pigs, a hoopoe, magpies and a genet share the acorn ground, onto a harvested bole oxblood above its grey cork casing, onto a pried plank's sawn face, into Hooke's hollow honeycomb, into one wall's waxy suberin courses, to a carbon atom's core in its wide fog, to a nucleus wrapped in a fog-shell many times wider — which reads again as the froth of nested shells at cosmic scale, each shell cored by its own small galaxy: home through an armless disk of star-haze and a world at its dusk line to the dehesa from the air

registers.name: carbon_atom
registers.palette: azure haze shells, garnet core spark, ink hollow
registers.scene: one carbon atom seated in the cork wall's grid, a tight garnet core point wrapped in a far wider azure haze that fades outward through fainter and fainter shells, four slender bonds tethering it to neighbouring cores that recede into ink hollow, a violet tremor over the grid, the ratio of the small core to its vast haze repeated at core after core, no ground and no horizon anywhere

registers.name: shelled_nucleus
registers.palette: garnet core spheres, azure fog-shell, ink void
registers.scene: a nucleus of lit spheres pressed into one shivering droplet, garnet and cream spheres crowded at its core, an enormous faint azure fog-shell rounding it many times wider than the droplet, two loose spheres adrift far out in that fog, a fainter froth of sparks pricking the outer fog, the whole two-part shape set in ink with no ground and no horizon

registers.name: nested_froth
registers.palette: azure shell-films, garnet cluster cores, ink void
registers.scene: a froth of nested fog-shells filling the void, each vast shell rounding smaller shells within it and those rounding smaller shells again, every shell cored by its own small galaxy as a garnet smudge, shell-films drawn faint azure where they touch and merge, threads of galaxies beaded across the seams, countless shells receding into ink void, no ground and no horizon anywhere

music_theme: a stately walk under evening oaks — warm marimba and kalimba figures over a round woody bass, a deep kick on every downbeat with a quieter thump answering on beat three, the plucking thinning to single struck notes through the plank, honeycomb and suberin bars, a wide struck bloom where the shelled nucleus opens out as a froth of nested shells, and a settling return figure through the galaxy and the dusk world back to the pasture
